top_signals.title: MiniMax Erases Post-IPO Gain as AI Model Rivalry Intensifies
top_signals.summary: MiniMax Group Inc. shares wiped out all of their gains since their January trading debut, as intense rivalry forces investors to reassess the Chinese artificial intelligence model developer.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
